verdict.rationale: The only event-driven automation in the evidence is that evaluators configured in the UI and attached to datasets automatically score outputs whenever an experiment runs. That is a narrow, eval-only form of rule-triggered action. Nothing shows a general rules engine for defining conditions on traces or production events that fire actions. Missing for 10: general user-defined trigger/condition rules, alerts or notifications on events, webhook or other action integrations, automatic online evaluation of incoming production traces, independent corroboration.
